## Content Review

The first pass preserves the approved ownership invariant throughout:

- producers retain atomic-cause and producer-local support/composite authority;
- each named scientific-use owner supplies and owns its exact admission policy;
- VAL supplies shared interchange types, knowledge-state and four-axis logic,
  immutable provenance, cause preservation, and deterministic execution;
- consumers retain estimator support, numerical action, and product-validity
  authority.

The formal core uses a partial eligibility proposition, preserves unknown and
conflict distinctly from explicit false, composes applicable restrictions by
false-dominant conjunction, proves the no-rescue property, permits only
same-policy cause-preserving exceptions, preserves exact/conservative and
confirmed/possible influence distinctions, enforces a nonretroactive stage
lifecycle, and makes aggregation equivalence owner-declared rather than
universal. The motivating retained/replaced occurrence demonstrates why a
single valid/invalid bit cannot represent the required scientific claims.

No PTC, MAP, producer, or other consumer scientific policy was transferred to
VAL. The engineering wrapper introduces no independent displayed science and
imports the same six canonical modules exactly once.
